description: The plot illustrates how overall ROUGE-G score varies with the number of training examples for several systems and their 5% variants. The x-axis is labeled “# Training Examples,” uses a linear scale, and shows values from 0 to 64 with labeled ticks at 0, 16, and 64. The y-axis is labeled “Overall ROUGE-G score,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly 11.0 to 19.0 with evenly spaced tick labels every 2.0 units (11.0, 13.0, 15.0, 17.0, 19.0). A solid green line with circular markers (PELMS) rises from about 16.7 at 0 examples to about 18.4 at 16 and about 18.7 at 64. A dashed green line with circular markers (PELMS (5%)) stays near 16.8 at 0, about 17.0 at 16, and about 17.9 at 64. A solid blue line with upward-triangle markers (Pegasus-X) increases from about 13.6 at 0 to about 15.4 at 16 and about 17.8 at 64. A dashed blue line with upward-triangle markers (Pegasus-X (5%)) drops from about 13.4 at 0 to about 11.6 at 16, then rises to about 14.0 at 64. A solid red line with square markers (Primera) increases from about 15.0 at 0 to about 17.1 at 16 and about 18.1 at 64. A dashed red line with square markers (Primera (5%)) is about 15.0 at 0, dips to about 14.6 at 16, and rises to about 15.8 at 64. A solid yellow line with diamond markers (Centrum) is about 15.9 at 0, about 16.0 at 16, and about 16.4 at 64. A dashed yellow line with diamond markers (Centrum (5%)) is about 15.8 at 0, about 15.6 at 16, and about 15.9 at 64.
